title: Character movement directly made by Claude - video update
author: LegendaryJohnny
selftext:
Here is short video of my latest attempt to make Claude create nice 3D model (still looks pretty bad), add motion capture for walking and running and turn it into 2D sprites which are added to the game (this looks good as terrible details on 3D model are lost in translation). There is nicely lit demo area. There I will just develop all ingame mechanics, systems and interactions, fighting system as well and when everything is working in this tiny area, I will polish story and start building whole world. "AI slop" my ass, doing all this as one man show is still extremely hard.

Anyway, here is my result so far after just few hours of working on this while I was bored doing my main project (postapo CCG). Maybe one day it will be postapo RPG. It is extremely entertaining for me and very addictive.

comments.author: Early_Flamingo5337
comments.body: Looking quite nice. Good job man
